profile.name: Lahiru Wijewickrama
profile.role: Lecturer, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering
profile.affiliation: General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, Sri Lanka
profile.bio: I am a mechanical engineer with a background in information technology, working at the intersection of mechanical engineering and computer science. My research interests span robotics, automation, control systems, and advanced materials, and I aim to pursue doctoral research in these areas. I teach Intelligent Systems and Control, Programming Fundamentals, and Industrial Engineering, and supervise final-year undergraduate research projects.

research.title: Fibre Reinforced Composites in Marine Deck Manufacture: A Review
research.meta: Centre for Future Materials, University of Southern Queensland × CINEC Campus
research.description: Evaluates the mechanical performance, durability and corrosion resistance of fibre reinforced composites for marine deck structures in harsh underwater conditions, with a focus on extending service life, lowering maintenance costs and improving sustainability. Published in MDPI Polymers.

research.title: Engineering Innovations in Perishable Vegetable Logistics: Digital Tools for Supply–Demand Management
research.description: Reviews Sri Lanka's post-harvest logistics challenges against international practice and identifies digital and engineering solutions that improve traceability, reduce spoilage and support food security.
